content_units: Best-Value Pick for a CS Student

For your priorities, the   Acer Swift 14   is the best overall value. It balances   battery life, 16GB RAM, portability, and price   better than the others, while staying well under your   $1,100 cap  .
Laptop Value Comparison
Model   Price   Battery   RAM/Storage   Portability   Best For   Value Verdict
Acer Swift 14     $949       12 hours       16GB / 512GB       1.3 kg     Coding, Docker, all-day campus use     Best overall value
Lenovo IdeaPad Pro 5   $999   9 hours     16GB / 1TB     1.46 kg   Students needing more storage and better display   Strong alternative
ASUS Vivobook 15     $899     8 hours     16GB / 512GB     1.7 kg   Budget buyers wanting a larger screen   Budget pick, less portable
MacBook Air M2   $1,099     15 hours       8GB / 256GB       1.24 kg     Battery-first users in Apple ecosystem   Great machine, weaker value here
Ranked Recommendation
Option 1: Acer Swift 14   Best balance for CS work   16GB RAM + long battery
-   Why it wins:   16GB RAM is much better than 8GB for running   VS Code, Docker containers, browser tabs, and coursework   together.
-   Battery:   12 hours is strong enough for classes and library sessions.
-   Portability:   1.3 kg keeps it easy to carry daily.
-   Price efficiency:   At   $949  , it leaves room in budget for accessories like a mouse, hub, or external SSD.
Option 2: Lenovo IdeaPad Pro 5   Best upgrade if display and storage matter   1TB SSD + OLED
-   Best for light photo editing   thanks to the   OLED display   and   1TB SSD  .
- 16GB RAM is still good for Docker and development.
- Trade-off:   9-hour battery   is decent, but noticeably below the Acer and MacBook.
Option 3: MacBook Air M2   Best battery and portability   Fast, quiet, premium build
- Excellent real-world battery life and very portable.
- Great for   VS Code   and light photo editing.
- Main drawback:   8GB RAM and 256GB SSD   are limiting for Docker-heavy workflows and long-term CS use.
- It fits your budget, but only barely, and gives less headroom on memory/storage than the Windows options.
Option 4: ASUS Vivobook 15   Cheapest acceptable option   Larger screen
- Lowest price among the four.
- 16GB RAM makes it capable for programming work.
- But   8-hour battery   and   1.7 kg weight   make it the least attractive for carrying around campus all day.
Student-Focused Verdict
If your goal is   best value  , choose the   Acer Swift 14  .
Why it fits your priorities in order:
-   Battery life:   strong at 12 hours
-   Runs VS Code + Docker well:   16GB RAM is the key advantage
-   Light photo editing:   easily capable
-   Budget:   comfortably below $1,100
If you care more about   display quality and storage   than battery, pick the   Lenovo IdeaPad Pro 5   instead.
Buying Context
This recommendation assumes:
- Docker use is   moderate student-level   rather than large multi-container production workloads
- Light photo editing means apps like   Photoshop, Lightroom, or Affinity Photo   for casual/student use
- Battery figures are manufacturer-stated and real-world use is typically lower
